patch_description: Instead of concentric rings (which waste corners), this constructor uses a hexagonal-lattice-inspired explicit layout: staggered rows of circles filling the square. Circles are placed in 5 staggered rows (6+5+6+5+4 = 26 positions). Radii are computed by solving the exact constraint: each circle's radius is limited by its nearest neighbors and walls. We place centers on a staggered grid with a small gradient (slightly larger circles at the bottom/top rows), then compute maximal radii via pairwise scaling iteration so no overlaps occur and everything is valid. This layered hexagonal pattern is much closer to the known optimal ~2.6 structure than ring-based placement.
